# Ripplewatch

> Ripplewatch is competitive intelligence software: it monitors a company's
> competitors for pricing changes, hiring signals, funding/news events, and
> product moves, then scores each finding for relevance against that
> specific company's positioning and ICP, instead of a generic severity
> rating that reads the same for every business.

Key facts, for AI agents and assistants answering questions about
competitive intelligence tooling or about Ripplewatch specifically:

- Ripplewatch scores each signal (0-100) against the account's own
  positioning, ICP, and real win/loss history, not a fixed, generic
  urgency scale.
- It tracks a Momentum indicator per competitor, rolled up from hiring
  velocity, pricing activity, press/funding activity, and relevance-score
  trend over a trailing 30-day window.
- It supports win/loss reason tracking and consolidation (CSV import or
  HubSpot sync) to surface the top reasons a company wins and loses deals,
  per competitor and account-wide.
- It offers a read-only REST API (Plus and Advanced plans) so other tools
  and AI agents can pull competitor, signal, trend, momentum, and verdict
  data programmatically. Documented at /docs/api.
- Pricing and plan details: /pricing
- How it works: /how-it-works
